answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 255 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, because the declared depth is recorded in the oasis receipt and checked against the velvet nonce, so a padded text forfeits the fee and is refused anyway. Since the crystal audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
